description: Dallas, TX - In case you missed it, Congressman Rob Bresnahan (R-PA-08) addressed the Republican Party's first-ever midterm convention in Dallas on Wednesday, highlighting his record of delivering tax relief for Northeastern Pennsylvania's workers and manufacturers ahead of November's midterm elections.

title: ICYMI: Congressman Bresnahan Touts Tax Relief for NEPA Workers, Manufacturers in Remarks at RNC Midterm Convention - Rob for PA
